
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; color: rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); background-color: rgba(253, 251, 247, 1); background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(229, 224, 216, 1) 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 1px); background-size: 20px 20px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; padding: 1.5em 1em"><p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在文档批量处理、内容审计、数据抽取等开发场景中，经常需要从 Word 文档中提取所有超链接信息（包括链接地址、显示文本、链接类型等）。本文基于 Free Spire.Doc for .NET 免费组件，介绍一种轻量、代码量少的实现方式，重点讲解核心逻辑与代码实现，供.NET开发者参考。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.25em 0 0.55em; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; font-size: 1.5em; color: rgba(217, 69, 69, 1); padding: 0.3em 0.6em; border-left: 5px solid rgba(217, 69, 69, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.06); border-radius: 0 12px 8px 0"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">一、方案概述</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在 Word 文档中，超链接以</span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 55%, rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.18) 55%)">字段（Field）</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 的形式存储。每个超链接字段包含两个核心部分：</span></p>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 1.75em; list-style-type: disc">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.35em"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 55%, rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.18) 55%)">显示文本（Anchor Text）</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> ：用户在文档中看到的可点击文字</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.35em"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 55%, rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.18) 55%)">URL 地址</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：超链接指向的目标地址</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">读取超链接的基本思路是：
1.加载 Word 文档
2. 遍历文档的所有节（Section）和段落（Paragraph）
3. 检查每个子对象是否为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.875em; background-color: rgba(248, 246, 242, 1); color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); padding: 0.15em 0.45em; border: 1px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-radius: 3px 7px 4px 9px; box-shadow: 1px 1px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.15)">Field</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 类型
4. 再进一步判断其 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.875em; background-color: rgba(248, 246, 242, 1); color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); padding: 0.15em 0.45em; border: 1px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-radius: 3px 7px 4px 9px; box-shadow: 1px 1px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.15)">Type</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 是否为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.875em; background-color: rgba(248, 246, 242, 1); color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); padding: 0.15em 0.45em; border: 1px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-radius: 3px 7px 4px 9px; box-shadow: 1px 1px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.15)">FieldType.FieldHyperlink</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">
5. 最后提取链接地址、显示文本</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.25em 0 0.55em; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; font-size: 1.5em; color: rgba(217, 69, 69, 1); padding: 0.3em 0.6em; border-left: 5px solid rgba(217, 69, 69, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.06); border-radius: 0 12px 8px 0"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">二、环境准备</span></h2>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.25em 0 0.55em; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; font-size: 1.25em; color: rgba(255, 77, 77, 1); display: inline-block; padding: 0.15em 0.5em; background-color: rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.08); border: 2px solid rgba(255, 77, 77, 1); border-radius: 4px 12px 6px 10px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1. 组件引入</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通过 NuGet 包管理器安装 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.875em; background-color: rgba(248, 246, 242, 1); color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); padding: 0.15em 0.45em; border: 1px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-radius: 3px 7px 4px 9px; box-shadow: 1px 1px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.15)">FreeSpire.Doc</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 包，或在程序包管理器控制台执行：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.15em 0; padding: 1.1em; background-color: rgba(253, 251, 247, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-right: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-left: 5px solid rgba(45, 93, 161, 1); border-radius: 6px 12px 8px 10px; box-shadow: 4px 4px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.12); overflow-x: auto"><code class="language-powershell" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.55">Install-Package FreeSpire.Doc
</code></pre>
<blockquote style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.15em 0; padding: 0.85em 1.1em; background-color: rgba(255, 249, 196, 1); color: rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-right: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-left: 5px solid rgba(255, 77, 77, 1); border-radius: 4px 16px 12px 6px; box-shadow: 4px 4px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.12)">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">说明：该免费版本存在页面数量限制，适合小规模文档处理场景</span></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.25em 0 0.55em; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; font-size: 1.25em; color: rgba(255, 77, 77, 1); display: inline-block; padding: 0.15em 0.5em; background-color: rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.08); border: 2px solid rgba(255, 77, 77, 1); border-radius: 4px 12px 6px 10px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2. 命名空间引用</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.15em 0; padding: 1.1em; background-color: rgba(253, 251, 247, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-right: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-left: 5px solid rgba(45, 93, 161, 1); border-radius: 6px 12px 8px 10px; box-shadow: 4px 4px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.12); overflow-x: auto"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.55"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> Spire.Doc;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> Spire.Doc.Documents;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> Spire.Doc.Fields;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> System.Collections.Generic;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> System.IO;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> System.Text;
</code></pre>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.25em 0 0.55em; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; font-size: 1.25em; color: rgba(255, 77, 77, 1); display: inline-block; padding: 0.15em 0.5em; background-color: rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.08); border: 2px solid rgba(255, 77, 77, 1); border-radius: 4px 12px 6px 10px">三、完整代码示例</h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word">以下代码演示了如何读取 Word 文档中的所有超链接，提取其显示文本和 URL，并将结果保存到文本文件：</p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.15em 0; padding: 1.1em; background-color: rgba(253, 251, 247, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-right: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-left: 5px solid rgba(45, 93, 161, 1); border-radius: 6px 12px 8px 10px; box-shadow: 4px 4px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.12); overflow-x: auto"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.55"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> Spire.Doc;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> Spire.Doc.Documents;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> Spire.Doc.Fields;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> System.Collections.Generic;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> System.IO;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> System.Text;
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">namespace</span> <span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(254, 196, 24, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">ExtractHyperlinks</span><br>
{<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">class</span> <span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(254, 196, 24, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Program</span><br>
{<br>
<span class="hljs-function" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">static</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">void</span> <span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(254, 196, 24, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Main</span>(<span class="hljs-params" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span>[] <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">args</span></span>)</span><br>
{<br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 1. 创建 Document 实例并加载 Word 文档</span><br>
Document doc = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> Document();<br>
doc.LoadFromFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">@"sample.docx"</span>);</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 2. 创建列表存储超链接</span><br>
List&lt;Field&gt; hyperlinks = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> List&lt;Field&gt;();</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 3. 遍历文档的所有节</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">foreach</span> (Section section <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> doc.Sections)<br>
{<br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 遍历节中的所有子对象</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">foreach</span> (DocumentObject secObj <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> section.Body.ChildObjects)<br>
{<br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 判断是否为段落</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> (secObj.DocumentObjectType == DocumentObjectType.Paragraph)<br>
{<br>
Paragraph paragraph = secObj <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">as</span> Paragraph;</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 遍历段落中的所有子对象</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">foreach</span> (DocumentObject paraObj <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> paragraph.ChildObjects)<br>
{<br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 判断是否为 Field 类型</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> (paraObj.DocumentObjectType == DocumentObjectType.Field)<br>
{<br>
Field field = paraObj <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">as</span> Field;</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 判断是否为超链接字段</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> (field.Type == FieldType.FieldHyperlink)<br>
{<br>
hyperlinks.Add(field);<br>
}<br>
}<br>
}<br>
}<br>
}<br>
}</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 4. 输出超链接信息</span><br>
StringBuilder sb = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> StringBuilder();<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">foreach</span> (Field hyperlink <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> hyperlinks)<br>
{<br>
sb.AppendLine(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"显示文本："</span> + hyperlink.FieldText);<br>
sb.AppendLine(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"URL地址："</span> + hyperlink.Code);<br>
sb.AppendLine();<br>
}</p>
<p>File.WriteAllText(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"Hyperlinks.txt"</span>, sb.ToString());</p>
</code><p><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.55">doc.Close();<br>
}<br>
}<br>
}<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.25em 0 0.55em; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; font-size: 1.25em; color: rgba(255, 77, 77, 1); display: inline-block; padding: 0.15em 0.5em; background-color: rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.08); border: 2px solid rgba(255, 77, 77, 1); border-radius: 4px 12px 6px 10px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">四、进阶：提取屏幕提示（ScreenTip）</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">部分超链接还包含屏幕提示（鼠标悬停时显示的文本）。通过解析字段代码（Field Code）可以提取这一信息。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">字段代码的典型格式如下：</span></p>
<figure class="figure-table" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.25em 0; text-align: center; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch"><table style="box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; font-size: 0.9375em; border: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-radius: 6px 14px 10px 8px; box-shadow: 4px 4px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.1); overflow: hidden; margin: 0"><thead style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0.55em 0.8em; border-top: none; border-right: 1px dashed rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-left: 1px dashed rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 249, 196, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">超链接类型</span></th><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0.55em 0.8em; border-top: none; border-right: 1px dashed rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-left: 1px dashed rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 249, 196, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">字段代码示例</span></th></tr></thead><tbody style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0.55em 0.8em; border: 1px dashed rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">标准超链接</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0.55em 0.8em; border: 1px dashed rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); text-align: left"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.875em; background-color: rgba(248, 246, 242, 1); color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); padding: 0.15em 0.45em; border: 1px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-radius: 3px 7px 4px 9px; box-shadow: 1px 1px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.15)">HYPERLINK "https://www.example.com"</code></td></tr><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background-color: rgba(229, 224, 216, 0.25)"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0.55em 0.8em; border: 1px dashed rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">带屏幕提示的超链接</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0.55em 0.8em; border: 1px dashed rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); text-align: left"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.875em; background-color: rgba(248, 246, 242, 1); color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); padding: 0.15em 0.45em; border: 1px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-radius: 3px 7px 4px 9px; box-shadow: 1px 1px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.15)">HYPERLINK "https://www.example.com" \o "ScreenTip"</code></td></tr></tbody></table></figure>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">提取屏幕提示的代码片段：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.15em 0; padding: 1.1em; background-color: rgba(253, 251, 247, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-right: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-left: 5px solid rgba(45, 93, 161, 1); border-radius: 6px 12px 8px 10px; box-shadow: 4px 4px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.12); overflow-x: auto"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.55"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 获取显示文本</span>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> anchorText = field.FieldText;
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 获取完整字段代码</span><br>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> fieldCode = field.GetFieldCode();</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 提取 URL（位于第一对引号中）</span><br>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> url = fieldCode.Split(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">'"'</span>)[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>];</p>
</code><p><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.55"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 检查是否包含屏幕提示（\o 参数）</span><br>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> screenTip = <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span>.Empty;<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> (fieldCode.Contains(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"\o"</span>))<br>
{<br>
screenTip = fieldCode.Split(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">'"'</span>)[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">3</span>].Trim();<br>
}<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.25em 0 0.55em; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; font-size: 1.25em; color: rgba(255, 77, 77, 1); display: inline-block; padding: 0.15em 0.5em; background-color: rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.08); border: 2px solid rgba(255, 77, 77, 1); border-radius: 4px 12px 6px 10px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">五、注意事项</span></h3>
<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 1.75em; list-style-type: decimal">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.35em">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 55%, rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.18) 55%)">文档格式兼容性</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：Free Spire.Doc for .NET 支持 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.875em; background-color: rgba(248, 246, 242, 1); color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); padding: 0.15em 0.45em; border: 1px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-radius: 3px 7px 4px 9px; box-shadow: 1px 1px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.15)">.doc</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 和 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.875em; background-color: rgba(248, 246, 242, 1); color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); padding: 0.15em 0.45em; border: 1px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-radius: 3px 7px 4px 9px; box-shadow: 1px 1px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.15)">.docx</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 两种格式，代码无需针对不同格式做特殊处理。</span></p>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.35em">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 55%, rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.18) 55%)">嵌套结构</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：Word 文档的对象模型是层级结构（Document → Section → Paragraph → 子对象），遍历时需要逐层深入。</span></p>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.35em">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 55%, rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.18) 55%)">性能考虑</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：对于大型文档，遍历所有对象可能有一定开销。如有性能要求，可考虑在识别到超链接后提前终止遍历，或使用更精确的查找策略。</span></p>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.35em">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 55%, rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.18) 55%)">免费版限制</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：Free Spire.Doc 对文档处理功能有部分限制（如文档页数限制），但对于常规的超链接读取任务通常足够使用。</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.25em 0 0.55em; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; font-size: 1.25em; color: rgba(255, 77, 77, 1); display: inline-block; padding: 0.15em 0.5em; background-color: rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.08); border: 2px solid rgba(255, 77, 77, 1); border-radius: 4px 12px 6px 10px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">六、总结</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通过以上示例，开发者可以用简洁的 C# 代码实现 Word 文档中超链接的批量读取。核心流程包括：加载文档 → 遍历节和段落 → 识别超链接字段 → 提取显示文本和 URL。这一方案无需安装 Microsoft Office，适合在服务器端或自动化流程中集成使用。对于需要进一步处理超链接的场景（如修改 URL 或显示文本），同样可以通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.875em; background-color: rgba(248, 246, 242, 1); color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); padding: 0.15em 0.45em; border: 1px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-radius: 3px 7px 4px 9px; box-shadow: 1px 1px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.15)">Field.Code</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 和 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.875em; background-color: rgba(248, 246, 242, 1); color: rgba(201, 48, 48, 1); padding: 0.15em 0.45em; border: 1px solid rgba(45, 45, 45, 1); border-radius: 3px 7px 4px 9px; box-shadow: 1px 1px rgba(45, 45, 45, 0.15)">Field.FieldText</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 属性实现。</span></p></section>
